sources.title: Qwen3 14b - AI Model Insights & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Deep dive into Qwen3 14b. Uniquely support of seamless switching between thinking mode (for complex logical reasoning, math, and coding) and non-thinking mode (for efficient, general-purpose dialogue) within single model, ensuring optimal performance across various scenarios. Significantly enhancement in its reasoning capabilities, surpassing previous QwQ (in thinking mode) and Qwen2.5 ...

sources.title: Qwen 3 14b model - NanoGPT
sources.snippet: Qwen 3 14b is a 14b model. Supports switching between thinking and non thinking: trigger thinking with /think and /no_think anywhere in a prompt or system message to toggle chain-of-thought reasoning.

sources.snippet: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.
